article.title: Golden State takes on Miami, looks for 6th straight win
article.linkText: Golden State takes on Miami, looks for 6th straight win
article.story: Miami Heat (2-5, ninth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (5-3, eighth in the Western Conference) San Francisco; Thursday, 10 p.m. EST LINE: Warriors -4.5; over/under is 238.5 BOTTOM LINE: Golden State comes into a matchup against Miami as winners of five games in a row. Golden State finished 37-45 overall a season ago while going 22-19 at home. The Warriors averaged 114.6 points per game while shooting 46.1% from the field and 35.6% from 3-point range last season. Miami finished 43-39 overall a season ago while going 17-24 on the road. The Heat averaged 120.9 points per game last season, 19.8 on free throws and 41.1 from 3-point range. INJURIES: Warriors: Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee), Gui Santos: out (knee). Heat: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
